match.kootaDisclaimer: These are the traditional meanings of each point — a guide to understanding the score, not a verdict on your relationship.
match.koota.varna.what: Spiritual outlook and who respects whose lead — how well your pride, purpose and attitude to work fit together.
match.koota.varna.high: Similar outlook on life; little friction over ego or goals.
match.koota.varna.mid: Partly aligned; talk openly about goals and roles.
match.koota.varna.low: Different outlook on status and purpose; mutual respect is needed.
match.koota.vashya.what: The natural pull between you and who tends to lead or give way in the relationship.
match.koota.vashya.high: Strong natural pull; each adapts easily to the other.
match.koota.vashya.mid: Some pull; one partner may lead more than the other.
match.koota.vashya.low: Little natural give-and-take; a tug-of-war for control is possible.
match.koota.tara.what: Birth-star harmony — the well-being and good fortune of the couple after marriage.
match.koota.tara.high: Your stars support each other; good health and fortune together.
match.koota.tara.mid: Mixed luck; take care over health and the timing of big decisions.
match.koota.tara.low: Stars pull against each other; extra care for health and major decisions.
match.koota.yoni.what: Physical and emotional chemistry — closeness, comfort and intimacy.
match.koota.yoni.mid: Decent chemistry; closeness grows with time and care.
match.koota.yoni.low: Different needs around closeness; patience and honest talk help.
match.koota.maitri.what: Mental wavelength — affection, friendship and how well you understand each other day to day.
match.koota.maitri.mid: Some differences in thinking, manageable with effort.
match.koota.maitri.low: Different wavelengths; misunderstandings are likely without effort.
match.koota.gana.what: Basic nature — gentle (Deva), balanced (Manushya) or intense (Rakshasa) — and how the two blend.
match.koota.gana.mid: Different temperaments that can balance each other.
match.koota.gana.low: Very different temperaments; tempers and habits may clash.
match.koota.bhakoot.what: Emotional bond and family welfare — also prosperity and how your finances grow together.
match.koota.bhakoot.high: Strong bond; shared prosperity and family harmony.
match.koota.bhakoot.mid: A fair bond; handle money matters together.
match.koota.bhakoot.low: Strain around money or family emotions (Bhakoot dosha may apply).
match.koota.nadi.what: Body-energy and genetic compatibility — the health of the couple and of future children.
match.koota.nadi.high: A healthy match for both partners and for children.
match.koota.nadi.mid: Partial match; regular health checks are wise.
match.koota.nadi.low: Nadi points are zero (Nadi dosha); traditionally advised to consult an astrologer.

hora.suits.Saturn: Good for steady, long-term work; avoid starting new ventures.
